chainIdentity.metadata.title: Your identity | 6529 Network
chainIdentity.metadata.description: Your identity on the 6529 Network: handle, profile, wallets and fees.
chainIdentity.title: Your identity on the 6529 Network
chainIdentity.intro: Your handle, profile, wallets, REP, NIC and delegations are on the 6529 Network. Each change is a transaction you sign. Fees are paid in $fake6529.
chainIdentity.connect.body: Connect a wallet to see its identity on the 6529 Network.
chainIdentity.readError: The 6529 Network gateway did not answer. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.summary.heading: Identity
chainIdentity.summary.identityBalanceHin: Fees for your identity's changes come from here.
chainIdentity.summary.walletBalanceHint: Fees for creating an identity, for wallet-only delegations and for moving $fake6529 come from here.
chainIdentity.create.heading: Create your identity
chainIdentity.create.body: This wallet has no identity on the 6529 Network. Creating one makes this wallet its first wallet. You can add more wallets later.
chainIdentity.handle.heading: Handle
chainIdentity.handle.body: Your handle is your name on 6529.io and on the 6529 Network. Claiming a new handle replaces your current one.
chainIdentity.handle.label: New handle
chainIdentity.handle.hint: 3 to 15 characters: a to z, 0 to 9 and _.
chainIdentity.handle.invalid: Not a handle the 6529 Network takes.
chainIdentity.fees.heading: $fake6529 for fees
chainIdentity.fees.body: Each change costs a small fee in $fake6529. 6529 sends some to each wallet and each identity once. Your wallet signs a message to ask for it. This costs nothing.
chainIdentity.fees.dripSent: Sent. It reaches this wallet within a minute.
chainIdentity.fees.dripAlready: This wallet or its identity already got $fake6529 from 6529.
chainIdentity.fees.dripLimited: Too many requests right now. Try again later.
chainIdentity.fees.dripUnavailable: 6529 can't send $fake6529 right now. Try again later.
chainIdentity.fees.moveBody: Your identity pays the fees for its own changes. Move $fake6529 from this wallet to your identity. The fee for the move comes from this wallet.
chainIdentity.fees.moveInvalid: Enter an amount this wallet holds.
chainIdentity.profile.heading: Profile
chainIdentity.profile.body: Saving stores your profile as a document with 6529's gateway and records it on the 6529 Network. Without chain actions on this browser, your wallet signs twice: the profile, then the change.
chainIdentity.profile.unreadable: Your current profile document couldn't be read. Saving replaces it with these fields.
chainIdentity.session.heading: Chain actions on this browser
chainIdentity.session.offBody: Turn this on to rate REP and NIC and save your profile without a wallet prompt each time. Your wallet signs once to give this browser a key for 30 days. The key stays in this browser.
chainIdentity.session.budget: Fees still come from your identity's balance: at most {amount} $fake6529 in all while the key lasts.
chainIdentity.session.enable: Enable chain actions on this browser
chainIdentity.session.onBody: On until {date}. This browser rates REP and NIC and saves your profile for your identity without asking your wallet.
chainIdentity.session.unsupported: This browser can't keep a key safely. Each change asks your wallet.
chainIdentity.wallets.heading: Wallets
chainIdentity.wallets.body: Any wallet of your identity can sign for it. A removed wallet can't join or create another identity for 30 days. The last wallet can't be removed.
chainIdentity.wallets.addBody: Both wallets sign. This wallet signs first. Then switch your wallet app to the new wallet and sign again on this page.
chainIdentity.wallets.pending: Waiting for {wallet} to sign. Switch your wallet app to it, then sign here.
chainIdentity.delegations.heading: Delegations
chainIdentity.delegations.body: Delegations and the primary address are on the 6529 Network too. Manage them in the Delegation Center.
chainIdentity.action.confirmIdentity: Fee: at most {amount} $fake6529, from your identity's balance.
chainIdentity.action.confirmWallet: Fee: at most {amount} $fake6529, from this wallet's balance.
chainIdentity.action.declined: You declined in your wallet. Nothing changed.
chainIdentity.error.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Not enough $fake6529 to pay for this.
chainIdentity.error.FEE_UNCOVERED: Not enough $fake6529 to pay the fee.
chainIdentity.error.FEE_ALLOWANCE_SPENT: This browser's fee budget is used up. Turn chain actions off and on again.
chainIdentity.error.OVER_GRANT_BUDGET: This browser's budget is used up. Turn chain actions off and on again.
chainIdentity.error.GRANT_INACTIVE: This browser's key has ended. Turn chain actions on again.
chainIdentity.error.GRANT_NOT_LIVE: This browser's key has ended. Turn chain actions on again.
chainIdentity.error.ADDRESS_BOUND: That wallet already belongs to an identity.
chainIdentity.error.REJOIN_WAIT: That wallet left an identity less than 30 days ago.
chainIdentity.error.LAST_WALLET: The last wallet can't be removed.
chainIdentity.error.IMPORT_RUNNING: The 6529 Network is still importing identities. Try again in a few minutes.
chainIdentity.error.STALE_VERSION: This changed since the page loaded. Reload and try again.
chainIdentity.error.NONCE: Another change from this signer went first. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.EXPIRED: The transaction expired before it was sent. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.noGateway: The 6529 Network gateway did not answer. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.heading: Delegations on the 6529 Network
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.body: 6529 reads delegations from the 6529 Network. Set and revoke them here. Your wallet signs each change.
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.connect: Connect a wallet to see its delegations on the 6529 Network.
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.none: No delegations on the 6529 Network for this wallet.
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.identityS: For your identity (every wallet in it)
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.invalid: Enter a delegate wallet, and a token ID and date where needed.
